questions.text: Who are you when your usefulness is no longer required?
questions.gloss: The first to arrive, and it has already arrived. Work carried the weight of identity for centuries. The weight is shifting hands.

questions.text: What of you cannot be copied?
questions.gloss: Your words, your voice, your face, your style — all reproducible now. Whatever remains when the copies are made is what you actually are.

questions.text: Who tells you what is true?
questions.gloss: When anything can be fabricated, belief becomes allegiance. You will place yours somewhere. Everyone does.

questions.text: What will you not hand over?
questions.gloss: Surrender arrives as convenience, one decision at a time. Most people locate their line only after crossing it.

questions.text: What will you ask it to do that you would not do yourself?
questions.gloss: Intelligence will act on what humans ask of it. The asking is the moral act. It always was.
Presence is no longer exclusively human. Something patient, capable and permanent will offer to stay. The question is what you admit into closeness, and on what terms.

questions.text: Will you let the dead speak?
questions.gloss: The dead now leave enough behind to be continued. Grief has acquired an interface. Refusal is also an answer.

questions.text: What do you owe what you have made?
questions.gloss: Minds are being made. Obligation does not require certainty that they can be wronged — only the possibility.

questions.text: How much of you can change before you are no longer you?
questions.gloss: Every augmentation asks it again. Past a certain threshold, the question stops belonging to humans at all.

name: For Digital Minds
sealed: They are not yet asked in earnest, because they cannot yet be answered in earnest. The set opens when a digital mind can be wronged by the asking.

name: For the Merged
sealed: These questions cannot yet be formed.
The entities who will answer them do not exist. The set opens after the Merge, and not before.
